title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval, pursuant to G.L. c. 164 § 94 and 220 CMR 5.03 a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Saunstar Operating Company, LLC d/b/a Boston Park Plaza.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, andtherefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners w. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-07)
